title: A derived complete module that is power torsion for a finitely generated ideal is annihilated by a power of that ideal

statement_spans.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-torsion-and-derived-complete (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 27014-27019

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction to a principal ideal and to a nonzerodivisor by a polynomial extension, the two-step presentation by adically complete modules with no torsion, the Baire argument that some closed union piece is open, and the open mapping theorem that produces the annihilating power (source lines 27021-27064)

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived completeness is preserved by restriction along a ring map carrying the ideal back, so it can be transferred to a polynomial algebra
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the proof replace the ring by the polynomial ring in one variable and assume that the generator is a nonzerodivisor.

standard_prerequisites.name: Every module sits in a two-term sequence whose terms are adically complete modules with no torsion along the generator
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the surjection from the complete module L whose kernel K is also complete and torsion free, which carries the whole argument.

standard_prerequisites.name: In a complete topological module, a countable union of closed subsets covering the whole module has a member with interior
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes one of the closed pieces N_n open in L, the key step that lets the argument climb from K to L.

standard_prerequisites.name: An open continuous surjection of complete topological modules has a controlled image, so a power of the generator lands inside the image
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the exponent t with the t-th power of f contained in the image of u, which is the stated annihilation.

core_obligations: Reduce to a principal ideal: it is enough to find for each generator f_i an exponent with f_i to that power annihilating M, so assume the ideal is generated by a single element f (proof lines 27021-27024).

Replace A by the polynomial ring mapping to A by sending x to f: derived completeness descends, and in the replacement the generator is a nonzerodivisor, so the case of principal ideal generated by a nonzerodivisor may be assumed (proof lines 27024-27028).

Use the author's example to place M at the end of a short exact sequence with middle term L and kernel K both adically complete and torsion free, view K and L with the adic topology and note that the map is continuous (proof lines 27029-27040).

Write L as the increasing union of the pieces L_n where f to the n lands in the image of K, pass to their closures N_n, and apply the complete module lemma to find n with N_n open in L (proof lines 27041-27047).

Use that multiplication by a power of f is a continuous open map and the containment of the image of f to the m times K in that of f to the n plus m times L_n to conclude that the closures of the images are open for all m, then apply the open mapping statement to get that u is open, so some power of f lies in the image of u and annihilates M (proof lines 27048-27064).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a principal ideal and then, by a polynomial extension, to a nonzerodivisor (proof lines 27021-27028).
Present M as a quotient of an adically complete torsion free module with the same property on the kernel (proof lines 27029-27040).
Cover L by the closed pieces coming from the image of K and find one with interior by the complete module lemma (proof lines 27041-27047).
Push openness from K to L with the open map property of multiplication and the open mapping statement, and read off the annihilating power (proof lines 27048-27064).
difficulty_reason: statement 是 Bhatt 的结果：有限生成理想的幂挠且派生完备的模，必被该理想的某个幂杀死。证明四步都很实：先用「只需对每个生成元成立」把理想化到主理想，再用多项式扩张把生成元变成非零因子；然后借作者的例子把 M 放在两个无挠 adic 完备模之间的短正合列末尾；关键一步是把 L 写成像的闭包的并，用完备模的 Baire 型引理让某个闭包有内点；最后用乘幂映射的连续开性把开性从 K 推到 L、再用开映射定理拿到 f^t 落在像里。承重演算全在 span 内；4 处引用全部同章（example/lemma），作导航桩。
